location.en: Kai and Mia's apartment, living room

goal.en: Throw Mia a surprise party and give her your gift.
goal.zh: 幫米亞辦驚喜派對，並把禮物送給她。

background: apartment living room at night decorated with balloons, plain paper garlands, a plain white birthday cake with candles on the table, wrapped gifts, warm string lights

intro.en: Today is Mia's birthday. You and Leo spent all afternoon decorating the living room.
intro.zh: 今天是米亞的生日。你和里歐花了一整個下午布置客廳。

intro.en: Keys jingle at the door. Leo turns on the lights just as Mia walks in.
intro.zh: 門口傳來鑰匙聲。米亞一走進來，里歐就打開了燈。

lines.en: Whoa! You two did all this for me?
lines.zh: 哇！這些都是你們兩個為我準備的？

choices.tip: 驚喜派對的經典開場：Happy birthday! 加上 Surprise!。

choices.en: Happy birthday! Today you are the biggest!

lines.en: The biggest? Are you saying I'm big?
lines.zh: 最大？你是說我很大隻嗎？

story.en: Mia hides behind a balloon. Leo spends five minutes explaining what you meant.
story.zh: 米亞躲到氣球後面，里歐花了五分鐘解釋你的意思。

fail.why: 「壽星最大」直翻成 you are the biggest 會變成「你最大隻」。英文說 It's your day! 或 Today is all about you!。

choices.en: Happy birthday, Mia! Are you surprise?
choices.zh: 生日快樂，米亞！你驚訝嗎？

lines.en: Am I... a surprise? I'm pretty sure I'm Mia.
lines.zh: 我是……一個驚喜？我很確定我是米亞耶。

story.en: Leo laughs so hard that he sits on the birthday hats.
story.zh: 里歐笑到一屁股坐扁了生日帽。

fail.why: 「感到驚訝」要用形容詞 surprised：Are you surprised?。surprise 是名詞，少了 -d 意思變成「你是一個驚喜嗎？」。

lines.en: I really am! This is amazing!
Kai, don't you have something for Mia? You know, behind the sofa?
lines.zh: 凱，你不是有東西要給米亞嗎？就在沙發後面那個？

choices.en: Oh, right! I got you something, Mia.
choices.zh: 喔，對！米亞，我有東西要送你。
choices.tip: I got you something. 是送禮時最自然的一句，簡單又溫暖。

choices.en: This is a small gift. It's cheap, sorry.
choices.zh: 這只是個小禮物，很便宜，不好意思。

lines.en: Oh... um, that's okay? I'm sure it's nice.
lines.zh: 喔……呃，沒關係啊？我相信一定很好。

story.en: Mia opens the gift very carefully, as if it might break. The mood gets a little weird.
story.zh: 米亞小心翼翼地拆禮物，好像怕它會壞掉，氣氛變得有點怪。

fail.why: 中文說「小東西，不成敬意」是謙虛，但英文強調禮物 cheap 會讓收禮的人尷尬。送禮時說 I got you something. 或 I hope you like it! 就好。

choices.en: Yes! I buy a present give you.

lines.en: You buy... give... wait, who's giving what?
lines.zh: 你買……給……等等，誰要給什麼？

story.en: Mia thinks she has to give you a present too. She runs to her room to find one.
story.zh: 米亞以為她也要送你禮物，跑回房間翻箱倒櫃。

fail.why: 「我買禮物給你」照中文順序排成 I buy a present give you 是中式英文。說 I got you something. 或 I bought you a present.。

lines.en: Mia opens the box. Inside is a soft yellow scarf.
lines.zh: 米亞打開盒子，裡面是一條柔軟的黃色圍巾。

lines.en: Oh my gosh! It matches my hair clip! I love it!
lines.zh: 天啊！跟我的髮夾好搭！我好喜歡！

choices.en: I'm so glad you like it!
choices.tip: 對方說 I love it! 時，回 I'm so glad you like it! 分享你的開心。

lines.en: Um... yes. I can see that.

story.en: Leo starts naming the color of everything in the room. Mia joins in. Somehow, it becomes a game.
story.zh: 里歐開始說出房間裡每樣東西的顏色，米亞也加入，莫名其妙變成一場遊戲。

fail.why: 對方說 I love it! 是在分享開心，不是在確認顏色。回應她的心情：I'm so glad you like it!

choices.en: Of course. It was very expensive.

lines.en: Oh... wow. Now I feel kind of bad.
lines.zh: 喔……哇，我現在覺得有點過意不去。

story.en: Mia is afraid to wear the scarf in case it gets dirty. It stays in the box all winter.
story.zh: 米亞怕把圍巾弄髒，整個冬天都不敢戴，一直放在盒子裡。

fail.why: 強調禮物很貴，聽起來像在邀功，也會讓對方有壓力。送禮的重點是心意，回 I'm so glad you like it! 就好。

lines.zh: 好，點蠟燭時間！大家安靜！

lines.en: You two are the best. I don't even know what to say!
lines.zh: 你們兩個最好了。我都不知道該說什麼了！

choices.en: Don't say anything. Just make a wish!
choices.zh: 什麼都不用說，快許願吧！
choices.tip: Make a wish! 是吹蠟燭前一定會說的一句。

choices.en: Make three wishes! Say two out loud!
choices.zh: 許三個願望！前兩個要說出來！

lines.en: Out loud? But then they won't come true!
lines.zh: 說出來？那樣就不會實現了啊！

story.en: Mia and Leo argue about wish rules for ten minutes. The candles melt onto the cake.
story.zh: 米亞和里歐為了許願規則爭了十分鐘，蠟燭都融到蛋糕上了。

fail.why: 台灣習慣許三個願望、前兩個說出來，但英語文化通常只許一個願望，而且要放在心裡，說出來就不靈了。

choices.en: Hurry up! I want to eat cake!

lines.en: Wow, okay. Happy birthday to me, I guess.
lines.zh: 哇，好喔。祝我自己生日快樂吧。

story.en: Mia blows out the candles in one second flat. Leo gives you the smallest slice.
story.zh: 米亞一秒就吹熄蠟燭，里歐切給你最小的一塊蛋糕。

fail.why: 壽星正感動的時候催她，氣氛會瞬間冷掉。說 Just make a wish! 把焦點放回壽星身上。

lines.en: Mia closes her eyes, makes a wish, and blows out all the candles.
lines.zh: 米亞閉上眼睛許了願，一口氣吹熄了所有蠟燭。

story.en: Mia wears the scarf all night, even while eating cake. Nobody notices Leo's wallet left on the sofa.
story.zh: 米亞整晚都圍著圍巾，連吃蛋糕時也不拿下來。沒有人發現里歐的錢包掉在沙發上。

notes.explain: 「壽星最大」直翻成 You are the biggest. 會變成「你最大隻」。英文說 It's your day! 或 Today is all about you!。

example.en: Sit down and relax. It's your day!
example.zh: 坐下來休息，今天你最大！

notes.explain: 描述人的感受用 -ed 形容詞：surprised、excited、bored。surprise 是名詞「驚喜」，不能直接放在 be 動詞後面形容人。
送禮時最自然的一句，可以再加 I hope you like it!。不用說禮物很便宜或很貴，重點是心意。

example.en: I got you something. I hope you like it!
example.zh: 我有東西要送你，希望你喜歡！

notes.explain: 吹蠟燭前一定會說的一句。吹蠟燭的英文是 blow out the candles。

example.en: Make a wish and blow out the candles!

notes.explain: 台灣習慣許三個願望、說出前兩個，但英語文化通常只許一個願望，而且不說出來，說出來就不會實現。

example.en: I can't tell you my wish, or it won't come true!
example.zh: 我不能告訴你我許了什麼願，不然就不會實現了！
